title: Demo ilan detayındaki kaynaksız çalışma koşullarını kaldırma
description: The demo detail page applies the same unsupported schedule and employer benefits to every seeded listing: 09:00-18:00 hours, two office days, Apple/4K equipment, and 22 days of paid leave. The seed data instead carries per-listing work-model descriptions (for example one hybrid day for the first listing) and a separate dynamic yanHaklar field. In the single assigned page file, remove the fabricated universal schedule/equipment/leave claims and present only existing listing-backed work arrangement and benefits where appropriate; do not invent replacements or alter database-backed rendering/application flow.
acceptanceCriteria: No universal hardcoded 09:00-18:00, two-office-days, Apple/4K device, or 22-day leave claim remains in demo detail; any replacement work arrangement uses existing per-listing listing data only; dynamic ilan.yanHaklar remains intact; unrelated demo content, database detail branch, CV upload and application submission remain unchanged; only the assigned page file changes; npm run kalite, npm run build and git diff --check pass; OpenCode does not commit.
lastError: Chief scope review found the handoff incorrectly appends ekMeta.izinTipiAciklama (permit category) to the work-schedule card. Remove only that item. Keep listing-backed schedule fields; do not modify other files. This is a correctable scope mismatch; retryable=true.
